PR 2 · generated Related block on reference pages

3 to 5 links, chosen by a score you can audit

Skill, agent and hook reference pages get a build-time Related block. The scorer in lib/related-pages.ts is deterministic: shared frontmatter category, shared tags, mutual references in page content, and a bounded bonus for orphan pages from the PR 1 audit. Optional Jev rerank sits behind ORK_SITE_JEV_RERANK and every failure keeps this exact order.

same kind +1 same category +4 shared tag +2 (cap 3) mutual ref +3 one-way ref +1 orphan target +2

Ties break by inbound count ascending (weaker-linked pages first), then url. The orphan bonus only stacks on a real relevance signal, so a zero-inbound page cannot outrank a weak but relevant one. Candidate metadata below is a 14-page subset of the real pool; the scoring code is the same function the site runs.
